'''March 2001 Greenwood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Game Times, Greenwood Park Mall, Greenwood, Indiana on 24 March 2001. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1960">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-greenwood-in-3-24-01d1960/ greenwood-in-3-24-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 26 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-greenwood-in-3-24-01d1960/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Game Times, Greenwood Park Mall, Greenwood, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
